questions.en: Which option forces revalidation for just one dependency during synchronization?
questions.fr: Quelle option force une nouvelle validation pour une seule dépendance lors de la synchronisation ?

anchors.text:
- To force uv to revalidate cached data for a specific dependency pass `--refresh-package` to any
  command (e.g., `uv sync --refresh-package ruff` or `uv pip install --refresh-package ruff ...`).

questions.en: Two project configuration files sit side by side. Which one takes precedence and what happens to the other file’s uv table?
questions.fr: Lorsque les deux fichiers de configuration du projet coexistent dans le même dossier, lequel est prioritaire et que devient la table uv de l’autre ?

anchors.text:
`uv.toml` files take precedence over `pyproject.toml` files, so if both `uv.toml` and
    `pyproject.toml` files are present in a directory, configuration will be read from `uv.toml`, and

facts.expected: The accompanying pyproject.toml tool.uv table is ignored.

anchors.text:
`pyproject.toml` files are present in a directory, configuration will be read from `uv.toml`, and
    the `[tool.uv]` section in the accompanying `pyproject.toml` will be ignored.

questions.en: For cache-modifying commands, give the default wait for other processes and the environment variable that changes it.
questions.fr: Pour les commandes qui modifient le cache, quel est le délai d’attente par défaut des autres processus et quelle variable permet de le modifier ?
